title: collapsedData — Collapsed Group Members Vanish from nodes[]
summary: When a group is collapsed, its member nodes are removed from top-level nodes[] and stored in groupNodeData.collapsedData with offset coordinates. collapsedData is NOT in the spec — it is a runtime-only payload. AI reading must check for it; AI writing must not create it from scratch.

title: The Dash in Node IDs — Never Use - in a Manual ID
summary: The plugin uses dashes to construct composite portal IDs (portalId-nodeId). Any manually-chosen ID containing a dash may be misidentified as a portal reference. Use underscores, camelCase, or alphanumeric IDs.

title: zIndex vs Array Order — Two Ordering Systems, One File
summary: The spec requires nodes[] in ascending zIndex order, but zIndex is also a per-node field. When zIndex is set on some nodes but not others, array position and visual order can diverge. AI must read zIndex explicitly, not assume array position reflects draw order.

title: ratio Can Be a String — Tolerate No ratio enforcement
summary: The spec defines ratio as number, but the plugin writes the string sentinel 'No ratio enforcement' when ratio enforcement is disabled. AI reading must tolerate both. AI writing should use numeric or omit.

title: Template definitions are plugin-setting data, not canvas JSON
summary: Templates are stored in plugin settings (data.json), not .canvas files. Template styleAttributes spread onto created nodes. AI reading sees only the resulting node.
